items.summary: Duncan Sheik has died. The New Jersey-born singer-songwriter, best known for the pop-rock hit “Barely Breathing” and the musical Spring Awakening , passed away last night in a hospital in Manhattan. His mother, Suzanne Sheik, told the New York Times the cause of death was cardiac arrest. "Duncan was a father, husband, son, brother, and friend," reads a statement shared on his social media.
